title: Traits of successful entrepreneurs and managers
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:31Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-01T08:14:02Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The bank point defines entrepreneurs, the risk of starting a business, and innovation's effect on competition, but it does not teach the personal traits (risk-taking, persistence, creativity, vision, planning, people skills) that the new point covers.

draft.title: Traits of successful entrepreneurs and managers
card: A trait is a quality in how a person thinks and acts. Some traits help entrepreneurs and managers succeed, though none guarantees success.
being willing to accept a chance of loss after weighing it up. Persistence is carrying on after setbacks.
creativity is coming up with new ideas. Vision is a clear picture of where the business should be in the future.
planning is setting goals and the steps to reach them. People skills are communicating with, motivating and working well with others, such as staff and customers.
draft.remember: Success is helped by a mix of traits: risk-taking, persistence, creativity, vision, planning and people skills.

a.q: Sam's online shop lost money for its first year. He reviewed what went wrong, kept going and changed his prices. Which trait does this show?
a.why: Sam carried on after a setback, which is persistence. Planning is setting goals and steps in advance, but Sam's main action here was not giving up after a loss.
a.clue: What did Sam do after the loss?

b.q: Priya manages a Geelong bakery. She holds a weekly meeting where she listens to staff worries, resolves a roster dispute and thanks the team. Which trait is she mainly using?
b.why: Listening, settling a dispute and motivating staff are people skills. Vision is a picture of the future of the business, but nothing in the meeting is about that.
b.clue: Look at who Priya is dealing with and how.
